'''William Schmidt''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 18 FL from Tempe, Az. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He learned the game in early 1996 at the Bookstar in Tempe, where he ran weekly events. Kendrick Summers recruited him after the 1996 Rebel Leader Tour stop there. In 1997 he hosted the 36-player [[1997 Tatooine Regionals (Phoenix)]], won by [[Jeremy LaMere]] over Brandon Allen, and in 1998 an Official Tournament Sealed Deck pre-release.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
